concept: IAM Identity Center: SSO via the corporate IdP (SAML)
tests: How to let employees sign in to AWS with corporate AD credentials and get temporary role-based access.
expected: IAM Identity Center federated with the corporate IdP/AD via SAML 2.0 (or via AD Connector); users get permission sets → temporary role credentials. Triggers: "existing corporate Active Directory credentials", "temporary access mapped to roles", "single sign-on".
why_not: An IAM user per person — duplicated identities and overhead; distributing access keys and a shared root — blatant anti-patterns.
